title: Let LRMs Break Free from Overthinking via Self-Braking Tuning
authors_zh: Haoran Zhao、Yuchen Yan、Yongliang Shen、Haolei Xu、Wenqi Zhang、Kaitao Song、Jian Shao、Weiming Lu、Jun Xiao、Yueting Zhuang
paper_type_zh: 推理轨迹重写与自制动微调配方
best_for_zh: 需要审计长 CoT 截断、停止监督与 OpenR1-Math 派生数据边界的读者
one_line: SBT derives masked/truncated math traces with braking prompts from OpenR1-Math.
SBT 从 OpenR1-Math 推导截断或掩码的推理轨迹并加入 braking prompt，以监督模型在冗余推理前自行终止；派生样本和决策账本尚未确认独立发布。
why: It exposes construction of accepted and masked trace segments without publishing the full ledger.
inclusion_reason: A trace-rewriting recipe for adaptive stopping supervision.

title: Problem
问题
html: Large reasoning models can reach a correct intermediate solution and then continue reconsidering, verifying, or exploring alternatives. Self-Braking Tuning turns this overthinking diagnosis into supervised trace rewriting: it identifies a braking boundary, retains productive reasoning, exposes but masks a small redundant segment, and inserts a natural-language stop cue. The primary data objects are OpenR1-Math source trajectories and two derived 92,064-example datasets, SBT-E and SBT-D. A first correct intermediate answer and marker frequency are construction heuristics, not proof that the removed reasoning is unnecessary or wrong.

大型推理模型可能已经得到正确的中间解答，却继续反思、验证或探索替代路径。Self-Braking Tuning 将这种过度思考诊断转化为监督式轨迹改写：识别制动边界，保留有效推理，暴露但 mask 一小段冗余内容，并插入自然语言停止提示。主要数据对象是 OpenR1-Math 源轨迹，以及各含 92,064 条样本的 SBT-E 和 SBT-D 派生数据集。首次出现正确中间答案与标记词频只是构造启发式，不能证明被删除推理一定无用或错误。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SBT scores each trajectory with a weighted overthink measure. The reasoning-efficiency component compares steps needed to reach the first correct answer with total thinking steps; the marker component counts curated reconsideration/verification expressions, with reported weights 90% and 10%. SBT-E keeps the Foundation Solution plus one Evolution Solution and masks the start of the next segment. SBT-D adds steps while recomputing the score, stops when it crosses a primary threshold (reported as 0.2), and masks a following score band. Both insert an epiphany-style braking sentence at the boundary and train only on unmasked tokens.

SBT 用加权 overthink score 评估每条轨迹。其中，推理效率分量比较首次得到正确答案所需步骤与全部思考步骤；标记分量统计人工整理的反思/验证表达，论文报告两者权重分别为 90% 和 10%。SBT-E 保留 Foundation Solution 与一个 Evolution Solution，并 mask 下一段开头；SBT-D 逐步加入推理并重算得分，在超过主阈值（报告为 0.2）时停止，再 mask 后续一个得分区间。两者都在边界插入类似顿悟的自然语言制动句，训练损失只覆盖未 mask token。

title: Method
方法
html:
The source is OpenR1-Math. The authors filter problematic formats and sequences above the 16,384-token training limit, yielding 92,064 instances. Trajectories are segmented into a Foundation Solution and subsequent Evolution Solutions or steps. Construction locates the first standard-answer occurrence, computes reasoning-efficiency and overthinking-marker ratios, combines them into a score, then applies either the fixed SBT-E or adaptive SBT-D boundary rule. A short redundant segment remains in the input with loss masking, while a natural-language braking cue is placed between retained and masked reasoning.

Models include Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The reported Megatron-LM setup trains three epochs with learning rate 1e-5, cosine decay, 0.03 warm-up ratio, and maximum length 16,384. Evaluation samples eight outputs per question at temperature 0.7 on GSM8K, MATH500, AMC23, and AIME 2024/2025. Official code is linked under Apache-2.0, but the metadata does not confirm an immutable data release containing every upstream ID, computed score, boundary, mask, rejected record, or source-to-derived lineage; those artifacts remain unknown.

源数据为 OpenR1-Math。作者过滤问题格式及超过 16,384 token 训练上限的序列，得到 92,064 条实例。轨迹被切分为 Foundation Solution 和后续 Evolution Solution 或步骤。构造流程定位标准答案首次出现位置，计算推理效率比与过度思考标记比，再组合为得分，最后应用固定的 SBT-E 或自适应 SBT-D 边界规则。一小段冗余推理保留在输入中但不计损失，自然语言制动提示插在保留内容与 mask 内容之间。

模型包括 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-1B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。论文报告使用 Megatron-LM 训练 3 个 epoch，学习率 1e-5、余弦衰减、warm-up ratio 0.03、最大长度 16,384。评测在 GSM8K、MATH500、AMC23 和 AIME 2024/2025 上以 temperature 0.7 每题采样 8 个输出。官方代码以 Apache-2.0 链接，但元数据未确认存在包含全部上游 ID、得分、边界、mask、被拒记录和源到派生血缘的不可变数据发布；这些工件仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports accuracy and average output tokens for four model families across four mathematical benchmark groups. SBT variants often reduce tokens substantially, but the accuracy tradeoff varies: some settings retain or improve accuracy, while others lose several points. Ablations compare step-level versus token-level detection, natural-language cues versus a special token or no guidance, and score components. The reported step-level and natural-language variants offer the best tested tradeoffs under their configurations.

These results evaluate models trained with the recipe. They do not verify that each braking boundary is semantically correct, that every masked segment is redundant, or that the two derived datasets are uncontaminated and properly licensed. Token reductions are not record-level data-quality evidence.

论文在四类模型和四组数学基准上报告准确率与平均输出 token。SBT 变体通常显著减少 token，但准确率取舍并不一致：部分设置保持或提高准确率，另一些则下降数个百分点。消融比较步骤级与 token 级检测、自然语言提示与特殊 token/无提示，以及各得分分量。报告设置下，步骤级检测和自然语言提示取得较好的已测试取舍。

这些结果评估的是按该配方训练的模型，不能验证每个制动边界在语义上正确、每段 mask 内容确实冗余，也不能证明两个派生数据集无污染且许可证完备。token 降幅不是逐记录数据质量证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work uses length penalties, fixed budgets, concise demonstrations, pruning, or learned stopping. SBT's distinctive construction is to combine a first-correct-step structural signal with a lexicon-based overthinking signal, create fixed and adaptive trace boundaries, retain a masked negative segment, and add a natural-language self-braking cue for SFT. OpenR1-Math, supervised fine-tuning, loss masking, and stop cues are not individually new. The direction signal is the explicit mapping from source trajectory to score, boundary, preserved segment, masked segment, cue, and trained response.

既有方法使用长度惩罚、固定预算、简洁示例、剪枝或学习式停止。SBT 的区别在于把首次正确步骤的结构信号与基于词表的过度思考信号结合，构造固定和自适应轨迹边界，保留一段 mask 的负向内容，并为 SFT 添加自然语言自制动提示。OpenR1-Math、监督微调、loss masking 和停止提示本身都不是新技术。其方向性信号是显式记录源轨迹到得分、边界、保留段、mask 段、提示与训练回答的映射。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The first textual occurrence of a correct answer need not mark completion of valid reasoning; later verification can expose a mistake or supply justification. Marker lexicons are language-, style-, and model-dependent, and reconsideration words can indicate useful correction rather than waste. The 90/10 weighting and SBT-D thresholds are heuristic. Masked text remains in the context and may influence predictions even though it contributes no loss, while natural-language cues may be imitated without reliable self-assessment.

The study focuses on mathematical traces and selected model families. Step segmentation, answer extraction, upstream OpenR1-Math provenance, filtering manifests, decontamination, derived-record licenses, boundary ledgers, and exact dataset availability are incomplete. Benchmark retention cannot establish the correctness or pedagogical value of individual shortened rationales.

正确答案第一次以文本形式出现，并不一定表示有效推理已经完成；后续验证可能发现错误或补充必要论证。标记词表依赖语言、风格和模型，反思词也可能表示有用纠错，而不是浪费。90/10 权重和 SBT-D 阈值属于启发式。被 mask 的文本仍在上下文中，虽然不计损失却可能影响预测；模型也可能只模仿自然语言制动句，而没有可靠的自我判断。

研究聚焦数学轨迹和若干模型系列。步骤切分、答案抽取、上游 OpenR1-Math 血缘、过滤清单、去污染、派生记录许可证、边界账本及数据集确切可用性都不完整。保持 benchmark 表现不能证明单条缩短理由正确或具有教学价值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
SBT is useful as a trace-rewriting schema. A reusable record should preserve upstream dataset and item ID, original trace, step segmentation, extracted intermediate answers, first-correct position, marker matches, both component scores, weights and thresholds, selected SBT variant, retained/masked spans, braking cue, loss mask, rejection reason, model/tokenizer revision, and evaluation outcome. This supports audits of whether removal targets redundancy or useful self-correction.

Downstream users should keep construction heuristics, masked supervision, answer correctness, and benchmark performance separate. The reported model results justify testing the recipe; they do not prove the missing decision ledger or shortened traces are high-quality data.

SBT 可作为轨迹改写 schema。可复用记录应保留上游数据集与条目 ID、原始轨迹、步骤切分、抽取的中间答案、首次正确位置、命中的标记、两个分量得分、权重与阈值、所选 SBT 变体、保留与 mask 区间、制动提示、loss mask、拒绝原因、模型/tokenizer 版本及评测结果。借助这些字段，可以审计删除的是冗余内容还是有用自纠错。

下游使用者应区分构造启发式、mask 监督、答案正确性与 benchmark 表现。论文的模型结果说明配方值得测试，但不能证明缺失的决策账本或缩短轨迹属于高质量数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Verify the source-to-derived record map and the actual availability of SBT-E/SBT-D data.
  • Audit first-correct-answer extraction and step segmentation before trusting braking boundaries.
  • Treat marker matches and overthink scores as heuristics, not process-correctness labels.
  • Preserve masked segments and loss masks so truncation decisions remain inspectable.
  • Compare token savings with accuracy, faithfulness, and licensing rather than using benchmark averages as data proof.

• 核验源记录到派生记录的映射，以及 SBT-E/SBT-D 数据是否实际可得。
  • 信任制动边界前，审计首次正确答案抽取与步骤切分。
  • 将标记命中与 overthink score 视为启发式，而不是过程正确性标签。
  • 保留 mask 区间和 loss mask，使截断决策可检查。
  • 将 token 节省与准确率、忠实性和许可证共同比较，不用 benchmark 均值证明数据质量。
